title: Incredible Oceanside Estate in Laguna, Beach
description:
Presented by HOM Sotheby's International Realty

For more information go to http://ow.ly/xwYeQ

Notably one of the finest oceanside locations in all of Emerald Bay. This property is over one third of an acre on a flat lot at the end of a cul-de-sac, with privacy plus incredible direct facing white water, panoramic, Catalina and sunset views. Originally built in 1955, the property today is a vintage single level beach side cottage with three bedrooms and two baths surrounding an expansive terrace overlooking the Pacific. 

Property ID: X43EJW
